purpose: Additional frozen, real-source fixtures for China, Africa, Europe and Japan. They extend the core seven-continent benchmark without changing its stable 19,455-record regression profile.

fixture_build.afsis_selection: at most 40 samples per source country and depth, ordered by SSN; groups with 40 or fewer are retained completely
fixture_build.foregs_selection: at most 12 sites per source country and medium, ordered by GTN; groups with 12 or fewer are retained completely
fixture_build.japan_selection: 600 evenly spaced rows after stable sample-id and duplicate-occurrence ordering
fixture_build.offline_fixture_note: The repository contains official files or official archives plus metadata/method snapshots. Archive members are independently hash-verified before adaptation.

required_tokens: Missing values are marked with value -1.0
changed to half the detection limit value

datasets.title: A comprehensive dataset of soil chemical and physical properties across China's mountain regions
datasets.publisher: National Tibetan Plateau / Third Pole Environment Data Center
datasets.citation: Yang et al. (2025), A comprehensive dataset of soil chemical and physical properties across China's mountain regions
datasets.license: TPDC attribution terms; share policy A; no standard license identifier stated
scientific_limits: The 1,314 observations cover 166 mountain sites and three source-reported horizons; they are not a uniform national grid.
All target elements are reported in mg/kg after HNO3-HF-HClO4 digestion; comparison with aqua-regia-extractable values requires basis separation.
The source workbook reports O/A/C horizons but does not publish exact top and bottom depth for every row; the adapter preserves the horizon and does not invent depth intervals.
The article is CC BY 4.0, but the TPDC data page states separate attribution terms without a standard license identifier; those must not be conflated.

datasets.title: Aqua regia wet chemistry data for a subset of AfSIS Phase I archived soil samples
datasets.citation: World Agroforestry, AfSIS Phase I archived soil wet chemistry dataset, version 2.0
scientific_limits: Aqua-regia results are quasi-total and must not be mixed with total or XRF values without measurement-basis grouping.
The expanded benchmark selects at most 40 samples per source country-depth group by SSN and is not an abundance-weighted continental sample.
Numeric values below the published batch detection limit are retained as published; the source provides no per-row censor qualifier, so the adapter must not invent one.
Country spelling corrections are limited to two documented source labels and the raw spelling remains traceable in the source locator.

datasets.title: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe — topsoil
datasets.citation: Salminen et al. (2005), Geochemical Atlas of Europe, Part 1; FOREGS topsoil database
datasets.license: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms (no standard SPDX identifier)
scientific_limits: The benchmark is capped per country and is not the complete FOREGS population.
Aqua-regia and mercury source files represent different analytical programs and remain method-separated.
The published files replace below-detection values with half the detection limit, so original censor qualifiers cannot be reconstructed.
National sampling density is too coarse for local contamination or small mineral occurrences.

datasets.title: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe — subsoil
datasets.citation: Salminen et al. (2005), Geochemical Atlas of Europe, Part 1; FOREGS subsoil database
datasets.license: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms (no standard SPDX identifier)
scientific_limits: The benchmark is capped per country and is not the complete FOREGS population.
Topsoil and subsoil are kept as distinct material labels and must not be silently pooled.
Below-detection values were pre-replaced by detection-limit/2 upstream.
Exact sampling-depth interpretation must use the atlas method documentation, not file-name inference alone.

datasets.title: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe — humus
datasets.citation: Salminen et al. (2005), Geochemical Atlas of Europe, Part 1; FOREGS humus database
datasets.license: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms (no standard SPDX identifier)
scientific_limits: Humus is an organic surface medium and must not be interpreted as mineral topsoil.
Only Ni, Cu, Zn, Pb and Hg are available from the selected compatible source files.
Below-detection values were pre-replaced by detection-limit/2 upstream.
The benchmark is capped per country and is not the complete FOREGS population.

datasets.title: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe — stream water
datasets.citation: Salminen et al. (2005), Geochemical Atlas of Europe, Part 1; FOREGS stream-water database
datasets.license: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms (no standard SPDX identifier)
scientific_limits: Water concentrations are reported in µg/L and cannot be compared numerically with solid-media mg/kg values.
Per-analyte fraction and method detail is not repeated in the CSV and must remain unspecified in row-level claims.
Below-detection values were pre-replaced by detection-limit/2 upstream.
The benchmark is capped per country and is not a temporal water-quality dataset.

datasets.title: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe — stream sediment
datasets.citation: Salminen et al. (2005), Geochemical Atlas of Europe, Part 1; FOREGS stream-sediment database
datasets.license: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms (no standard SPDX identifier)
scientific_limits: The benchmark is capped per country and is not the complete FOREGS population.
Aqua-regia-extractable values are not total concentrations.
Below-detection values were pre-replaced by detection-limit/2 upstream.
Stream and floodplain sediment are distinct materials and remain separated.

datasets.title: FOREGS Geochemical Atlas of Europe — floodplain sediment
datasets.citation: Salminen et al. (2005), Geochemical Atlas of Europe, Part 1; FOREGS floodplain-sediment database
datasets.license: FOREGS/EuroGeoSurveys/GTK attribution and copyright terms (no standard SPDX identifier)
scientific_limits: The benchmark is capped per country and is not the complete FOREGS population.
Aqua-regia-extractable values are not total concentrations.
Below-detection values were pre-replaced by detection-limit/2 upstream.
Floodplain sediment integrates catchment and depositional processes and is not a point-source attribution measurement.

datasets.title: Geochemical Map of Japan — nationwide river-sediment data
datasets.citation: Geological Survey of Japan, Geochemical Map of Japan, nationwide river sediment sample information and concentration tables
datasets.license: Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use 2.0 / compatible with CC BY 4.0
scientific_limits: The benchmark uses a value-independent 600-sample spatial screening slice, not all published Japanese records.
The source CSV does not repeat element-specific analytical methods; the adapter references the atlas and does not invent a method family.
Most elements are ppm while Hg is ppb; units must be normalized element by element.
Sample id 78013 occurs twice in both official tables; occurrence order is preserved rather than silently deduplicated.

datasets.title: Chemical compositions of deflatable soil fractions from North Africa
datasets.citation: Guinoiseau et al. (2022), Chemical compositions of deflatable soil fractions from North Africa
scientific_limits: The samples target deflatable fine soil fractions for dust-provenance research and are not a general agricultural-soil baseline.
Border locations are retained without forcing a single country label; country is inferred only where the published Location is unambiguous.
HF-HNO3 digestion and ICP-MS values must remain separated from aqua-regia and XRF measurement bases.
The number and location of samples reflect a scientific source-area design, not national area weighting.

required_blind_spots: Antarctica remains literature-derived rock coverage only.
Latin American soil and sediment observations remain sparse in the bundled fixture and should be expanded through national surveys.
Country presence is a pipeline coverage check, not proof of national representativeness.
FOREGS below-detection values were replaced upstream by half the detection limit and cannot recover original censor qualifiers.
No bundled medium is a complete global population estimate.
